quote: House-made wheat noodles are boiled to order in shared ramen water; no gluten-free preparation exists, so cross-contamination with wheat is unavoidable.
found: 「自家製麺 併設の自社製麺所で毎朝製麺した自家製麺は醤油ベースのスープによく絡み、モチモチとしたコシのある食感が特徴です。」 The page is a shoyu-ramen 専門店 page with an in-house noodle factory and carries no allergen, gluten-free or celiac wording anywhere.
note: Core claim stands: own-milled ramen noodles, zero GF provision on the operator's own page. Narrow the wording — the page never mentions a shared noodle-boiler, that half is our inference; and the group's 麺屋優光 page states the noodles are 「全粒粉による小麦の香りと、うどん粉をブレンド」, i.e. wheat plus udon flour, which is the stronger sentence to cite.

quote: The broth's defining element is a special soy-sauce (shoyu) tare made with traditional Kyoto soy sauce; Japanese soy sauce is normally brewed with wheat, so the broth contains wheat-derived gluten.
found: 「京都の出汁文化を地元京都、日本、そして世界に発信することを目標にした醤油ラーメン専門店です。」 and 「チャーシューの油と混ざることで完成する麺屋聖の特製醤油スープを3種類ご用意しております。出汁、醤油の美味しさを感じてください。」
note: Shoyu-tare claim is supported verbatim (three 特製醤油スープ). But the page says 京都の出汁 culture, not Kyoto SOY SAUCE — the 「京都醤油など数種類の醤油をブレンド」 line exists only on the Nagoya-Sakae branch's Instagram, which is sibling-branch evidence. Reword to 'a house special shoyu soup' unless an Ichijoji-specific source for the Kyoto-shoyu blend is found. No 小麦不使用 or tamari claim is made anywhere, so the wheat inference is the safe reading.

quote: Broth is built on shellfish dashi (oyster, clam, shrimp) and the shop's centerpiece is pork chashu; no vegan or vegetarian bowl is offered, so there is no animal-free option to protect from cross-contact.
found: The cited official page never says 貝出汁 at all — it says only 出汁/醤油. The shellfish detail is on a March-2026 Ichijoji visit report: 「貝出汁ベースの醤油ラーメン。牡蠣、あさり、しじみの旨味を凝縮した一杯」 (address-matched: 京都府京都市左京区一乗寺払殿町48 コーポ吉沢).
method: 1 plain fetch + Ecosia exact-term search + 1 iPhone-UA fetch of the blog
note: Two fixes. (1) Attach the 58-gourmet post for the shellfish dashi; the official page only evidences the pork half (「独自の方法で豚肉を徹底的にやわらかくし」) and the all-meat menu (肉餃子/豚丼), which does support 'no vegan bowl'. (2) The third shellfish is wrong: しじみ is a freshwater CLAM, not shrimp — 牡蠣・あさり・しじみ. A shellfish-allergic reader avoiding crustaceans is being given the wrong hazard. Also flag the cited page as menu-stale: it still lists ギフト/シンプル/しるし 800円 while the shop moved to 淡竹/真竹/黒竹 with rare pork chashu by March 2026.

why: Open. The group's own site still lists 麺屋聖kiyo among its live branches with 京都市左京区一乗寺払殿町48 コーポ吉沢, tel 075-606-5459, 11:00-15:00 / 17:30-22:00, 定休日 木曜・不定休; a March-2026 visit report (published 2026-04-09) eats there and gives the same address and phone; Tabelog 26031309 carries no 閉店/移転/掲載保留 banner. Only change is a menu rename (ギフト/シンプル/しるし → 淡竹/真竹/黒竹) and a switch to rare chashu.

quote: The broth is finished with a soy-based (shoyu) seasoning and soy sauce is available at the table for adjustment — standard wheat-containing shoyu, not gluten-free.
found: 「スープは「鶏ガラ・野菜」がスープベース（出汁）。味付け（タレ）は醤油ダレですが塩味控えめで鶏の旨味を味わうラーメンという感じです。」 and 「卓上に醤油ダレ（ラーメンダレ）があるので調整すると良いでしょう。」
note: Exact match, both halves — shoyu tare and a table-side shoyu bottle. Strengthen the record with the noodle sourcing the same page gives: 「製麺所は…麺屋棣鄂（ていがく）」, a wheat ramen-noodle maker, and note the 和牛ラーメン / 和牛ユッケ重 / とりチャーシュー丼 line-up which independently confirms vegan_status 'no'.

why: Open, and very new. quote: The defining feature of the bowl is a deep, jet-black soy-sauce broth/tare in the Shinpuku Saikan style; soy-sauce tare of this type is standard wheat-based shoyu, so the ramen should be treated as containing wheat.
found: 「新福菜館出身の店主さんが切り盛りするラーメン店。新福のDNA感じるブラック醤油ラーメンとヤキメシは絶品。」 and 「中華そば 850円 漆黒のブラックスープ。醤油の香り感じる鶏ガラ豚骨醬油スープは醤油の風味に豚骨のコクと旨味が絶妙にマッチ。」
method: 1 plain fetch, corroborated by 1 plain fetch of the shop's own site
note: Fully supported, including the Shinpuku-Saikan lineage. The shop's own menu page corroborates it four times over (中華そば 「適度な醤油の香り」, チャーシュー麺 「醤油ダレの味が染み込んだチャーシュー」, 味付煮卵 「特製の醤油ダレに漬け込んだ」, 焼き飯 「醤油の香ばしさ」) — add http://ryugen.asia/menu as a second source. No tamari, no 小麦不使用, no allergen page anywhere; price is now 900円 not 850円.

quote: Broth is a pork-bone and chicken base with pork-loin chashu, and the yakimeshi is cooked with pork; there are no plant-based items, so cross-contact with animal products is total.
found: 「鶏ガラ豚骨醬油スープ」 and 「豚ロースチャーシュー、もやし、刻みネギとともに豪快に食せます。」 The yakimeshi-contains-pork half is NOT on this page (it says only 「隠し味を入れて炒めたヤキメシ」); it is on the shop's own menu: 「焼き飯…たっぷり入ったチャーシューから出る旨味成分と醤油の香ばしさがよくマッチして」.
method: 1 plain fetch + 1 plain fetch of the operator site
note: Claim is true but split across two pages — attach http://ryugen.asia/menu for the pork-in-yakimeshi element. The operator menu also adds 生卵 and 味付煮卵 (egg) and キムチ, so 'no plant-based items' holds: the only non-animal lines are ライス, メンマ, ネギ and beer.

why: NOT closed — 長期臨時休業, and the distinction matters. The shop's own news page, posted 2026/07/24 14:31 under the heading 「長期臨時休業のお知らせ」, says 「誠に勝手ながら来月8月の4日からまたしばらくお休みさせて頂きます」「再開時期は当ホームページ、Instagram、店頭の貼り紙にて告知致します」. So it has been shut since 2026-08-04 with no announced reopening date, and today is 2026-08-21. Context from the same feed: 2026/07/09 「来たる7月21日に開店10周年を迎えます。度々の長期臨時休業やメニュー変更等ご迷惑をお掛けして」 and 2026/06/18 「体調面の問題で…ヤキメシの販売を休止」 — these are recurring health-related closures by a 10-year-old owner-operated shop, and it reopened once already on 2026/04/23 (「営業再開のお知らせ」). The site is live and updated daily (visitor counter dated 2026.08.21). Show the record with a 'temporarily closed, check before travelling' state; do NOT hide it as 閉店.

quote: The bowls are shoyu-tonkotsu based; the soy-sauce tare used in this style of ramen standardly contains wheat.
found: 「家系ラーメン 中 肉増し 1,150円 濃厚な豚骨のコクに、醤油の強さ、まろやかな甘みが感じられます。」 and 「中華そば/唐揚げセット 1,050円 …豚清湯醤油スープは出汁と芳醇な醤油の食欲がそそります。」
method: 1 plain fetch + iPhone-UA fetch of s.tabelog.com to confirm identity
note: Right shop despite the misleading slug: the URL says ramen-nishiki because the article opens 「2021年にオープンした「中華そば 錦 本店」。2023年10月に店名を「麺家 澤希」へリニューアルしています」 — same premises, renamed, not a sibling branch. Two accuracy fixes: (a) 'the bowls are shoyu-tonkotsu' over-generalises a deliberately multi-style menu (家系・淡麗系・博多系・京都醤油系・昔ながらの中華そば・魚介・豚骨・塩・台湾) — say the flagship 家系 and 中華そば are shoyu-tonkotsu; (b) the page carries harder gluten evidence than the tare inference: 「五島製麺の太麺」 wheat noodles, and a 唐揚げ set (＋380円で唐揚げ3個とごはんセット) that means a shared fryer. Address on the page 京都府京都市左京区一乗寺北大丸町14 フラッツ一乗館 1F matches Tabelog 26036477 exactly.

quote: The broths are finished with soy-sauce-based tare (Japanese soy sauce / white soy sauce), which is wheat-containing, and the noodles are wheat ramen noodles.
found: 「トロっとした濃厚な鶏白湯のスープベース（出汁）に甘辛の風味がする黒醤油タレを合わせたシッカリとした味付けのラーメンです。」 and 「名物は泡白湯ラーメンで、鶏ガラと丸鶏の鶏白湯をスープベース（出汁）に白醤油ダレを合わせたクリーミーな濃厚スープで食べるラーメンです。」
method: 1 plain fetch + iPhone-UA fetch of s.tabelog.com for trading status

quote: Standard ramen tare and an emulsified chicken-pork broth are used; no allergen breakdown is published, but a wheat-based shoyu tare is typical for this style.
found: 「まずはスープ。鶏豚骨ベースの白湯スープは乳化しており、ひと口すすれば厚みのある豊かな旨みに驚きます。」 and 「卓上にはタレや黒胡椒、酢などが用意されており、味変も楽しめます。」 The page publishes no allergen information of any kind.

Upgrade the evidence though: this page states the gluten outright, which the record does not use — 「麺は老舗「棣鄂（ていがく）」製のストレート中細麺。小麦の風味が豊かで、しなやかなコシと喉ごしの良さが特徴。」 小麦 is named. quote: All bowls are animal-based (chicken-pork bone broth, meat toppings, chicken paste); no vegan or vegetarian preparation exists, so cross-contact is unavoidable for plant-based diners.
found: 「ラーメンは「肉白湯そば」「鶏中華そば」「辛肉まぜそば」の3種類。サイドメニューには鶏のからあげやごはん類も揃い充実。」, 「チャーシューに白ネギ、糸唐辛子、そして特製の鶏ペーストがのった」, 「スープの旨みをまとった豚ロースチャーシューは、しっとりやわらか。」
note: Exact match on all three elements — the whole three-bowl menu is meat, the toppings are pork-loin chashu, and the 鶏ペースト is literally chicken paste stirred into the soup. Nothing plant-based exists on the page, so vegan_status 'no' is correct and no tier change is warranted. Minor: the article's own body says 左京区・上賀茂 while its 店舗情報 gives 京都市北区上賀茂西後藤町11-7 — the record's 'Kita-ku, Kamigamo' is right and the article's ward is the error.

method: 1 plain fetch + iPhone-UA fetch of s.tabelog.com for trading status

Every bowl on the menu is wheat; there is no rice-noodle or GF option to ask for.

quote: Soy sauce is provided as a table condiment and the seasoning base is sesame/soy-style; standard Japanese soy sauce contains wheat, and no wheat-free tamari is indicated.
found: 「調味料は「ラー油・にんにく辣油・粉唐辛子（一味）・花椒・黒胡椒・塩・醤油・お酢」です。」 — 醤油 is listed among the table condiments. But the tare itself is described as sesame only: 「味付け（タレ）は程良い香りのゴマペーストです。」
note: The table-condiment half matches verbatim; the 'seasoning base is sesame/soy' half over-reads the page, which attributes the tare to sesame paste alone and never says the tare contains shoyu. Narrow it to: shoyu sits on the table as an optional condiment, the described tare is sesame. This does not make the shop safer — the noodles and the wonton skins are wheat regardless — but the record should not put shoyu in the bowl when the source puts it on the table.

quote: The broth is animal-based (chicken with some pork) and shrimp wonton is on the menu, so the kitchen is not set up for vegan separation.
